_comment: EXAMPLE roster for `organism orchestrate`. Copy to ~/.claude/state/organism-fleet.json (or point ORGANISM_FLEET_CONFIG at it) and replace the placeholder agents. One agent per repo. model and effort default to opus and high; handoff defaults to true (false closes the agent without /harvest, and the history says so); brief defaults to <repo>/HANDOFF.md; role is shown by `orchestrate roster` (default: the first line of the repo's CLAUDE.md). launch is the command `orchestrate summon` runs in the repo, per agent or for all; {model}, {effort}, {name} and {repo} are filled in. herdr is the herdr-core command (default hc). Before a start, summon checks that the machine has room; with none, it harvests and closes the agent idle longest. Optional: auto (false turns this off), max_live (most agents at once), min_free_mb (memory kept free, default 15% of the machine), session_mb (what one session needs, default 400), idle_minutes (how long an agent is idle before `orchestrate tend` closes it, default 10).
